forbidden_regressions: legacy RESET / AKCJA / U NAS labels
touch-only participation where a no-touch route is required

front_matter: how the book works / recurring-label explanation
required_checks: no split that separates a safety clause from the activity it governs
START / W DWIE OSOBY / NA JUTRO remain visibly distinct
Happy Makers comments remain readable and visually subordinate to instructions
body type remains comfortably readable at final trim size

editorial_safety_review: instructions are executable without guessing missing steps
age register remains natural for family use and not babyish
consent language remains optional and non-coercive
touch activities preserve a genuine no-touch alternative where required
movement activities do not reward unsafe speed
pair/group variants remain logically workable for stated group sizes
humor does not undermine safety, consent, or family dignity
no new factual, medical, psychological, or therapeutic claim is introduced by layout copy
evidence_required_for_pass: exact rendered file or deterministic render artifact identity
source hash binding to R5 blob
print-scale screenshots or page renders for all required surfaces
review disposition for every flagged page: PASS or bounded FIX
confirmation that any FIX is packaging/layout-only unless owner explicitly reopens body copy
pass_rule: PASS only when exact-source-bound template-fit evidence is green and all editorial/safety checks are PASS with zero unresolved BLOCK or FIX.

on_failure.layout_or_typography_issue: return bounded fix request to gentle_steps lane; do not rewrite body copy
on_failure.copy_or_safety_issue: open a minimal localization-owned surgical edit with exact segment allowlist and rerun all guards
